about: A player's personality (public/shared/performers/personality.js; docs/PLAYER_PERSONALITY.md): how far it pushes its instrument's idiom and what lines it prefers, each lever a draw from its seed within the range here, or given (a spec's, an LLM's later). Every range holds the line planner's own value (line.js LINE, wind-line.js WIND_LINE, flute_clodbot.js FLUTE), so that a personality is a place among the planner's settings, never outside them.

personality.about: The levers, each a share 0 to 1 drawn from the player's seed (its ensemble's seed, its identity and its instrument), read across its range here; daring is the one that reaches toward the instrument's limits (its facts, instrument-facts.js), tone the one from a clean tone to its extremes -- its techniques, its rhythmic grammars and its ranges in its tone's parameters -- the rest its style.

dynamicSteps.reason: how many dynamic marks the most daring player goes past the dynamics comfortable in a register (wind-line.js WIND_LINE lowMost f and highLeast p): to fff low and ppp high, the scale's ends (dynamics.js)

shortest.reason: its quickest note, the most daring's the planner's own (line.js LINE.shortest: a wind's double tonguing near it), the least daring's a single-tongued note's at some 8 notes a second (Bertsch & Hoole 2014, players-ranges.mjs repeatRate)

phraseRange.reason: a phrase's widest range, from a tenth to two octaves and a half as it dares, about the planner's 14 (line.js LINE.phraseRange)

density.reason: its density: from its motif's main notes alone, 0, to every held note divided at its quickest, 1 -- the line planner's whole span (line.js planLine: a phrase sparser than the motif it was made at simplified, a denser one divided), its motif made at its density among equals (flute_clodbot.js FLUTE, 0.35; bowedstring_clodbot.js BOWEDSTRING) and that among them (the owner, 5 November 2026: "changing the personality parameters doesn't seem to be able to result in any real extremes"; CLAUDE.md, range before personality)

loudness.reason: its loudness, from a line kept to ppp's edge to one at fff's, about the flute's 0.5

fioriture.reason: its fioriture as a soloist, from none to a run on every long note that has room for one, about the flute's 0.35

leap.reason: a leap's chance in its motif, from a motif all steps to one mostly leaps, about the planner's 0.18 (line.js LINE.leap)

slurs.reason: its longest slur of quick notes, from every one tongued, 1, to sixteen under one slur, about the planner's 4 (LINE.slurMost)

slurSegments.reason: the share of its phrase's segments slurred whole, long notes and all (line.js LINE.slurSegments), on the slurs' draw: from long notes always separate -- the planner's own, none -- to a legato player's every segment one slur, tongued where each begins

motifFewest.reason: its motif's fewest notes, with motifMost on the one draw motifLength: the planner's 3 to 6 (LINE.motifNotes) among them

motifMost.reason: its motif's most notes, on motifLength's draw with motifFewest, from a motif of a few notes to a long one

runs.reason: a run's most steps one way outside an ornament, from a line that turns at every third note to one that runs an octave and more, about the planner's 4 (LINE.runMost)

rests.reason: the silence after its cadence, a share of the bar's last group, about the planner's 0.5 (LINE.restShare)

commas.reason: the comma after its idea, a share of its last note, from none to most of it, about the planner's 0.2 (LINE.commaShare)

landing.reason: how high above its floor a cadence may land, a share of its span, about the planner's 0.75 (LINE.landing's upper end)

grammarLeast.reason: the least weight a motif's grammar is given, against the most preferred's 1, so that every grammar stays open to it (line.js chooseMotif)

quoting.reason: how often, where it was given motifs, its motif is one of them rather than its own: from never to always

techniques.reason: its tone: how often a phrase of its takes an extended technique its instrument sounds (techniques.js: a hum, a growl, a flutter, a harmonic, a multiphonic; a mute as often), from the cleanest tone's none -- the planner's own, a soloist having played none -- to the most extreme's every phrase, each still the instrument's own

toneWidth.reason: its tone: how wide its range in each of its tone's parameters (personality.js TONE_RANGES) -- its vibrato's width, a technique's depth, its bow's pressure and contact -- from the cleanest tone's tenth of the span about the ordinary to the most extreme's whole span, at its tone times a share each range draws its own (personality.js drawPersonality: of two extreme characters, one may range over every vibrato and the other keep to one)

figureWidth.reason: its taste in figures (figure-space.js drawTaste): how wide its range in each dimension of the figure space, from a cautious player's, near the one figure it favours, to a daring one's, over much of the space, at its daring times a share each range draws its own (ours)

vibratoMost.reason: its tone: the widest vibrato a character's range reaches (the owner, 3 November 2026: "some performer characters might allow huge vibrato ranges; others not"), three times its players' measured width (vibrato.js): on the violin's 40 c, 120 c peak to peak, as wide as professional lyric singers' mean extent of +-71 c (Prame 1997, doi:10.1121/1.419735); its share 1/3 its players' own, the ordinary a clean tone keeps about

harmonicPartials.reason: its tone: the natural harmonic a phrase of a bowed string takes, its partial by its technique's depth -- the octave at a shallow one, the twelfth at a deep one: the string touched at its half or its third, the two natural harmonics a string player most plays and the surest to speak

tuplets.reason: its lean on the piece's rhythm on the rhythm engine (opening-time.js rhythm, line-rhythm.js, where its player is switched to it): how far it draws the piece's share of divisions other than the meter space's own two and three (meter-space.js METER_SPACE.layers: a five, seven or thirteen in the time of one, wherever the span holds it at its quickest note) toward 1, or toward 0 below the middle -- from halfway to none to halfway to as much as a three, the piece's own at its middle: a weight on the piece's, never its own in its place (the owner, 6 November 2026: a player's personality never holds the piece's surface rhythm)

syncopation.reason: its lean on the piece's rhythm on the engine: how far it draws the piece's share of spans syncopated (euclidean.js syncopate, opening-time.js rhythm) toward wherever one fits, or toward never below the middle, the piece's own at its middle; a syncopation's length, meter, repeats and the syncopation within it are the piece's alone (the owner, 6 November 2026: "make sure the player-personality doesn't have some specific surface-texture or rhythm items (e.g., re: specific syncopations) confused with personality items")

rhythmicGrammars.reason: its tone: how far its motifs' rhythmic grammars' shares are drawn toward 1 -- a rhythm on a repeated tone, unequal durations, a rest inside it (line.js LINE.grammars) -- and the others' toward 0, from the cleanest tone's -1/2 (the rhythmic ones halfway to 0, the others halfway to 1) to the most extreme's 1/2: the planner's own, none, at the middle

themes.reason: its lean toward restating its themes: how often a phrase of a section that states its theme restates it, from its first note (themes.js), rather than developing it -- from a line that states its theme only where its form brings it, 0, to one restating it in every phrase its form lets it, 1, about the planner's own 0.5 (line.js LINE.restate); a section that develops its theme restates it a share of that (registry/method/melody.json themes developing)
